in_marathi.name: Jainendra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jainendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jainendra is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words ‘jina’ meaning ‘victor’ and ‘indra’ meaning ‘lord’. This name is believed to signify a victorious and powerful lord. In Hindu mythology, Jainendra is also identified as Lord Indra, the god of rain, thunderbolts, and storms.
